content.short: Mera builds high-performance wallet infrastructure from a team with HFT and low-level systems roots.
content.description: Mera, built by Category Labs, comes from a team with high-frequency trading and low-level systems engineering backgrounds, and applies that to wallet infrastructure where latency is treated as a first-order concern. Monad's documentation lists it under embedded wallets. That engineering lineage is shared with Monad itself, whose performance claims rest on similar systems work.
content.meta: Mera builds high-performance embedded wallet infrastructure from a team with HFT engineering roots.
